name: The Siege of the Ten Titans: The Indomitus Chapter Fleet Boss Engagement

cycle_advancement.world_state: Fleet Encounter Active: Kathryn Vane Faces the 100,000 HP Ultramarines Armada

locations_modified.ambient_tension: The orbital horizon is an unbroken wall of ceramite, macro-battery barrels, and blue void shields. 10 Ultramarines capital warships—bearing 100,000 combined structural HP and hundreds of lance batteries—aim their broadsides straight down into Hive Tartarus.

completed_milestones.title: The Full Chapter Fleet Encounter Formally Engaged
completed_milestones.consequence: Kathryn Vane, The Void Ascendant, scanned the heavens and identified the combined might of the Ultramarines Indomitus Retribution Fleet: a staggering 100,000 HP armada commanded by First Captain Agemman, armed with cyclonic planet-killer torpedoes.

active_disasters_and_trials.name: The Siege of the Ten Titans (Armada vs Void Avatar)
active_disasters_and_trials.threat: The Ultramarines Chapter Armada (100,000 HP, 10 Capital Ships) is preparing a simultaneous cyclonic broadside to annihilate Hive Tartarus and Kathryn Vane.
active_disasters_and_trials.human_trial: Break through the orbital void shields and systematically dismantle the Chapter Fleet using the combined apocalyptic might of the Void Singularity and Lord Malgakor's immortal essence.

threat_tracking.sublevel_containment_rating: ⚠️ CHAPTER-LEVEL EXTINCTION THREAT // 100,000 HP ARMADA LOCKED

loc_shrine_aquila.threat: 👑 KATHRYN VANE (528 HP) // VOID SINGULARITY READY

active_combat_encounters.boss_name: The Ultramarines Indomitus Retribution Armada (10 Capital Warships)
active_combat_encounters.current_phase: Phase 1: Orbital Macro-Battery & Cyclonic Torpedo Bombardment Grid (100,000 / 100,000 HP)
active_combat_encounters.armor_status: Overlapping Chapter Void Shields (75% Damage Reduction)
active_combat_encounters.tactical_requirements: The armada possesses 100,000 HP behind layered void shields. The Void Ascendant must unleash planetary-scale void singularities, shatter their void shields, or board the flagship 'Pride of Macragge' to decapitate First Captain Agemman.
active_combat_encounters.failure_consequences: Total glassing of Hive Tartarus by cyclonic torpedoes.

new_decision.decision: Scanned the tactical auspex and map to assess the approaching Chapter armada: ten capital warships with over 100,000 combined HP and massive planet-cleaving firepower; stood firm atop the floating Basilica ruins, channeling the full abyssal power of Malgakor to wage war against the entire fleet.
new_decision.impact: Engaged the 100,000 HP Ultramarines Armada in direct, apocalyptic combat.
